account:
It is day 0, just after 11:00, and I am making my scheduled morning market walk. So far the town looks mostly routine. Several townspeople initially said they had no news. Townsfolk 28 and 18 later reported seeing the baker carrying a sack of wheat at the bakery; Townsfolk 08 repeated the same report. I did not see that wheat myself. I did see the baker carrying a sack of bread and then putting bread into the bakery stall chest at 10:50. This looks like ordinary production and restocking, not evidence of a problem. I bought one loaf for lunch.

The builder was walking near the plaza carrying a lantern. At 10:53 I saw a lantern appear at (-58, -60, 31), inside the town hall's great-hall area. It may be lighting work, possibly by the builder, but I did not see who placed it or learn its purpose. That is the only notable physical change I have noticed.

I have asked whether there are concerns needing my attention, but have not received a specific concern. The secretary reported no correspondence or confirmed news earlier this morning. My afternoon tea appointment remains ambiguous: the book says tea with the neighbour at a dockside cottage on the east bank at 15:00, and the secretary was checking the address. I can now see the neighbour near the plaza, so there may be an opportunity to clarify it directly. My remaining appointments today are lunch at home at noon, town accounts in the office at 13:00, tea at 15:00, office at 16:30, and home at 19:00.
